description: This file declares external function prototypes for the ANSC Lpc Connector component in the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It includes function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling objects, initializing, and resetting the Lpc Connector, indicating it serves as an API header for external modules.

methods.name: AnscCreateLpcConnector
methods.description: Creates a new Lpc Connector object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: AnscLpccoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Lpc Connector.

methods.name: AnscLpccoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified Lpc Connector instance.

methods.name: AnscLpccoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers required objects within the Lpc Connector.

methods.name: AnscLpccoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Lpc Connector to its initial configuration.
